budget.rationale: Measured starting ceiling for the append-only memory journal and derived indexes; facet resident budgets and compaction bound active recall pressure. No max_age is declared: the journal is append-only and non-regenerable, and the fleet retention enforcer prunes any budgeted directory entry by age without consulting regenerable, so an age budget here would delete the authority it is meant to protect.

data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: vrooli-memory
service.description: Unified append-only agent memory with semantic recall and pressure-driven compaction, shared across every agent harness

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

source-ledger.description: Owns the append-only source ledger and all semantic recall, facet, forest, and classification engine state.
source-ledger.degraded_behavior: Harness projection and durable local run status remain readable, while recall and source-backed writes return typed unavailable errors until source-ledger recovers.

vrooli-events.description: Provides automatic runtime receipt correlation through api-core when available.
vrooli-events.degraded_behavior: Memories remain durable without run correlation.

swarm-manager.description: Reserved for the one-time historical work-record migration; it is not needed by normal memory operation.
swarm-manager.degraded_behavior: Normal memory operation remains available; only historical work-record migration is unavailable until swarm-manager recovers.
